privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: App: Veritas Keept (Android/iOS) • Last update: January 19, 2026
privacy.intro_text: Your privacy is our priority. This document explains how Veritas Keept processes, collects, and protects your data.
privacy.perm_camera: Camera & Gallery (Google ML Kit): Used solely for scanning documents. Pre-processing happens locally on-device.
privacy.perm_mic: Microphone: Used only upon explicit user request for voice notes. Recordings are transcribed and deleted immediately.
privacy.perm_bio: Biometrics: The app uses system APIs for identity verification. We do not access your biometric patterns.
privacy.cloud_text: To provide features (OCR, expense analysis), anonymized document data is processed by AI models (Google Gemini). Data is stored in secure Google Firebase infrastructure (EU/US).
privacy.delete_intro: In accordance with data safety guidelines, we provide two methods to permanently delete your account:
privacy.delete_m1_desc: Go to: Settings > Security > Delete Account. Data vanishes instantly.
privacy.delete_m2_desc: If you cannot access the app, send an email to:
privacy.delete_footer: Email requests are processed within 30 days, permanently removing all data from Firebase servers.
